name: TrustRadius Product Scores
description: Field-level structure of the TrustRadius scoring payload, as returned by GET /product-scores (operationId product_scores). Derived field-for-field from #/components/schemas/ProductScores in the provider-published OpenAPI.

fields.name: products[].id
fields.description: Product identifier, as returned by GET /product-ids.

fields.name: products[].trScore.max
fields.description: The maximum the TR Score is measured against. Read the score relative to this rather than assuming a fixed range.

fields.name: products[].starScore.max
fields.description: The maximum the star score is measured against.

fields.name: products[].ratingCount
fields.description: Number of ratings. Counted separately from reviews.

fields.name: products[].ratingsAndReviewsTotalCount
fields.description: Combined total. Not necessarily reviewCount + ratingCount — use the provider's own total when reporting.
